description: President signs Law 406 approving the new 20-year Cobre Panama contract (signed in the evening, so first trading day is Monday); protests start the same week
confounders_notes: Protests begin within days; good news and bad news overlap in one window. Decision 29 Oct 2026: context only

description: President Cortizo (Sunday) announces a referendum on the contract; FQM falls up to ~31% intraday, Franco-Nevada up to ~10%
confounders_notes: Strongest and cleanest shock of 2023; FQM falls again on Oct 31

description: National Assembly strips the contract-revocation clause from the moratorium bill; FQM rebounds ~11%
confounders_notes: Day 0 moved from 11-03 to 11-02 (30 Oct 2026): Assembly removed the revocation clause on Thu 2 Nov and FM rose that day; further ~11% on 3 Nov. LUN Q3 results hit 2 Nov (excluded).

description: FQM ramps down one ore-processing train after boat blockade of Punta Rincon port
confounders_notes: First physical supply disruption; smaller market reaction

description: FQM ramps down further to one remaining processing train
Supreme Court declares Law 406 unconstitutional during trading on 28 Nov (day 0); President Cortizo announces closure in a televised address after the close (reaction on 29 Nov = day +1)
confounders_notes: Two news items: ruling (day 0) and closure order (day +1); separated only for North American listings, Asian firms see both on 29 Nov. FM closed -0.8% on 28 Nov (Reuters). FQM arbitration notice dated 14 Nov, disclosed 1 Dec. Court sessions began 24 Nov (anticipation).

description: China Smelters Purchase Team sets Q1 2024 TC/RC guide at $80/dmt and 8.0 c/lb (Q4 2023: $95 and 9.5 c)
confounders_notes: Not for equity event study; use for TC/RC chart

description: President Mulino says the decision on the mine's future will come by June 2026; plan to process stockpiles
confounders_notes: Verify whether remarks came during or after TSX hours

description: S&P revises First Quantum outlook to positive, expects restart in H1 2026
confounders_notes: Day 0 moved from 02-11 to 02-10 (30 Oct 2026): S&P revision public at 11:04 ET on 10 Feb. Window [0,0] only: 11 Feb has FQM Q4 results, US payrolls and copper +2.5%.

description: Government-commissioned audit finds the mine broadly compliant (88% score)
confounders_notes: Audit public ~11:23 ET on 19 Jun (TSX open). NYSE closed (Juneteenth) so NYSE day 0 = 22 Jun; 23 Jun sector sell-off at NYSE +1 (FCX, SCCO, TECK excluded).

description: Mulino address: any solution will not go through a contract law; decision pushed to year-end
confounders_notes: Reference date moved to 07-01 (30 Oct 2026): address ~14:00 ET on 1 Jul, NYSE open so NYSE day 0 = 1 Jul; TSX closed (Canada Day) so TSX day 0 = 2 Jul automatically.

description: FQM accelerates restart preparations (stockpile processing, +~1,000 workers)
Ministerial commission recommends an 'orderly closure' (restart only to fund closure, no extension); FQM falls up to ~31-38% intraday, trading halted
confounders_notes: Announced ~08:50 Panama / during TSX hours. Same-day Reuters report of restart talks: sign mixed. ANTO Centinela strike vote (excluded). China holiday 1-7 Oct.
